formula.ascii: Riley: TRI = sqrt(sum over the 3x3 window of (z_k - z_centre)^2), in elevation units (the centre term is 0). terrainRuggednessAlgorithm wilson uses sum(|z_k - z_centre|)/8 instead. With edgeMode nodata the outer ring and any window with an invalid sample are NaN; extrapolate (gdaldem -compute_edges) extends outside samples linearly (2a - b) and replaces invalid neighbours by the centre.
